goals.description: Clear the workspace and inspect the pack of lentils.
goals.rationale: The person clears the kitchen top and attempts to open the lentils pack while reading its labels.

goals.description: Retrieve the colander and set up the scale for measuring.
goals.rationale: The person fetches a plastic colander from the cupboard and places it on the kitchen scale to prepare for measuring the lentils.

goals.description: Find scissors, open the pack, and measure the lentils into the colander.
goals.rationale: After failing to open the pack by hand, the person locates scissors, cuts the pack open, and pours the lentils into the colander on the scale.

goals.description: Rinse and drain the lentils multiple times.
goals.rationale: The person takes the colander to the sink and repeatedly washes and drains the lentils under running tap water.

goals.description: Perform a final rinse and drain of the lentils.
goals.rationale: The person fills the colander with water for one last rinse, lets it sit, and then drains the water completely before setting it aside.
